summary: This bill amends the Social Security Act to provide no-cost Medicare coverage for blood tests that detect perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) starting January 1, 2028.

scores.thoughts: This bill expands Medicare coverage to include no-cost PFAS testing, which directly relates to public healthcare by increasing access to a specific medical service for seniors. This is a clear expansion of public healthcare benefits.

The bill mandates Medicare coverage of PFAS testing with 100% federal payment and no cost-sharing beginning in 2028, directly increasing federal outlays under title XVIII. This expansion of an entitlement program is the central purpose of the legislation.

The legislation adds a new preventive service to Medicare and eliminates beneficiary cost-sharing, constituting direct government action to expand coverage and reduce out-of-pocket costs for seniors. This is the sole and explicit objective of the bill.
